remote.text:
Remote controls

Arrows: move between tiles
OK: play the highlighted channel
Back: go back one screen
Home: leave Tony

While watching:
Up / Down: next or previous channel
OK: show the channel list
Back: return to Home

preview.text:
Live preview

Rest on a tile for about one second and it starts playing silently inside the tile. Move away and it stops.

channels.text: Channel names shown here are examples only. The real list comes from Free-TV, filtered to the countries picked on first run. Broken channels are hidden automatically.
